# Assert the outgoing error element after correcting the outgoing hostname

The current manual-config browser test checks the outgoing error span while invalid, then its final hidden assertion queries incomingConfigTemplate and incomingHostnameErrorMessage even though the message says outgoing. Proposed focused test correction: target outgoingConfigTemplate/outgoingHostnameErrorMessage for that final state, and retain the separate edited-configuration/disabled-Continue assertion. This is a static assertion-target gap, not a reproduced test failure or proof the outgoing error stays visible. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: Account Hub manual error test target.
